title: GitHub release asset input
description: One file published on a GitHub release, addressed by repository, tag and asset name. A rolling tag that is re-uploaded in place is pinned by recording the immutable URL it resolved to.

source.description: A game.json source whose provider is github-release.

asset.description: The exact asset file name on the release.

updatedAt.description: RFC 3339; informational for a mutable tag.

resolvedCoordinate.description: The immutable URL a floating tag resolved to.
